title: CiteGuard MCP: Zero-Dependency Model Context Protocol Server and CLI for Scientific Citation Verification, Chimera Hallucination Detection, and Retraction Screening
description: Zero-dependency Python Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and command-line interface (CLI) that verifies scientific citations (DOIs, PubMed PMIDs, and arXiv IDs) in real time across Crossref, DataCite (CERN Zenodo), PubMed (NCBI E-utilities), OpenAlex, and arXiv. Detects fabricated identifiers, LLM chimera metadata mismatches (valid DOIs paired with fabricated titles, authors, or years), and formally retracted papers, and generates canonical BibTeX bibliographies.
